page: Google Cloud Platform c4a-highmem-32-lssd is a memory-optimized server instance powered by the arm64 CPU architecture. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs and 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance utilizes NVMe SSDs for local storage, though it does not include any graphics processing units.

This hardware configuration is designed for memory-intensive workloads that benefit from the power efficiency and architecture of arm64 processors. The 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio makes it suitable for running high-density databases, in-memory caching layers, and enterprise applications. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without resource contention, offering a qualitative balance of high memory capacity and compute resources for scale-out workloads.
